purpose: Automatic context window per simulated tier with speculative decoding off, so the choice does not depend on local weights. The draft-head tiers are gated in Tools/planner_gates.sh with a placeholder head.
schema_note: Version 3 changes only tier 24. With retained conversations charged inside the active context, the 65,536-token window at 25.8 GB keeps 44 experts per layer and adds 9.5% to the typical request, within the 10% limit, so auto takes it instead of 32,768. Tiers 16, 32 and 48 keep their windows. These tiers run with speculative decoding off; with the draft head a real 48 GB Mac (51.5 GB, 40.2 GB working set) now gets 32,768 tokens, gated in Tools/planner_gates.sh. Versions 1 and 2 stay as historical fixtures.
